1d.revise_if: BTC reclaims 65,000 or real yields reverse lower.
1d.reason: Bitcoin is near 61,760 after falling more than 3% on the day and 20% in a month, tracking gold lower as real yields surge to multi-year highs. ETF outflows have been heavy this month. The same macro force driving gold is the dominant near-term driver.
1d.own_view: Bitcoin is behaving like a high-beta gold proxy right now; the selling is more about rates than crypto-specific news.
1d.risk: Further ETF outflows or a break of the 58k support zone.

1w.revise_if: BTC reclaims 65,000 or real yields reverse lower.
1w.reason: Same real-yield pressure hitting gold continues to weigh.

6m.revise_if: BTC reclaims 65,000 or real yields reverse lower.

models.year: I expect Bitcoin to recover substantially over the next year as the rate cycle peaks and risk appetite returns, though volatility will remain elevated.

models.name: Step 5 Preview

1d.revise_if: A weekly close below 57,700 (trend broken) or the 10Y back under 4.80% (liquidity returns).
1d.reason: Bitcoin is 61,760, -3.37% on the day, -20.05% on the month and only 7% above the 52-week low, with crypto liquidations past $1.9bn as it neared $63,000. The November rout is driven by Fed hike fears, weakening institutional demand and forced selling.
1d.own_view: BTC is trading as a high-beta liquidity asset in a tightening cycle - its correlation to the ten-year is now stronger than to the halving cycle, and that is the regime to trade until the Fed stops.
1d.risk: A hawkish December plus a leverage flush that takes it through the 52-week low in days.

models.year: 2027 is a rebuilding year: a wide 55-90k range, with the recovery led by ETFs and corporate treasuries only once US rates peak; the 2026 high is not retested before mid-year.
